name: post-tool-use-bash-stderr
description: A Claude Code PostToolUse hook for the Bash tool whose tool_response carries a non-empty stderr maps to a ToolEvent that CARRIES both streams — the failure text, not only the intent. It is deliberately NOT hinted command_failed: measured over 1217 real Bash results, all 266 non-empty stderr values were the harness's own "Shell cwd was reset to …" notice and zero were failures, while real failures print to stdout. The payload exposes no exit code and never sets is_error, so `interrupted` is the only honest failure signal (see 07). The distiller reads the captured output and judges for itself.
